meta.description: Registry for blockers preventing theorem promotion, including unresolved quantifiers, equivalence gaps, and closure gaps.

blocker_classes.description: Universal or existential quantifiers require explicit boundary and domain specification.
Equivalence relations require formal proof of reflexive, symmetric, and transitive properties.
Edge cases (null states, infinite CSI, etc.) must be formally classified or scoped away.
A dependent reduction chain or operator relation contains an open closure gap (e.g. RC-001).
No formal proof file has been registered for the target theorem level.

blockers.description: Universal quantifier for x in MT-001 and existential for continuation_event in MT-003 require explicit bounds.
admissibility_equivalence and local_process_state_equivalence require formal definition and property verification.
Window collapse, residue drift, and branch explosion cases require explicit formal handling.
